description: Updates ONE tag: rename, data type, logical address and the external accessible/visible/writable flags. Only the fields you pass change, and only those that differ from the current value are written (none passed: 400 missing_param; all unchanged: 200 with changes:[]). A rename is refused with 409 name_collision (details.collidesWith = the colliding tag, constant or block) when the new name matches, ignoring case, another tag, constant or block of the PLC; an unknown table or tag is 404 not_found. The result carries `changes` [{field,from,to}] and `overlaps`: the OTHER tags whose address overlaps the final one (informational, never a refusal). dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve (needs an open project): it runs the same guards and returns that plan WITHOUT changing anything. Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/tagtables/{table}/tags/{tag}. M-off.

dataType.description: new data type (e.g., Bool, Int, Word)

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

table.description: tag table that holds the tag
